svg.text: Product manager or analyst to Analyst API: Questions and reports, JSON and HTML over HTTP, no auth (request and
MCP host to klaritics-analytics MCP server: MCP tool calls with a bearer token (request and reply)
make ask CLI to Event store: Analyst in-process, read-only SQL (request and reply)
Seeder to Event store: Writes the store once at image build (bulk or scheduled data)
Analyst API to Event store: Read-only SQL through the in-process MCP server (request and reply)
klaritics-analytics MCP server to Event store: Read-only SQL (request and reply)
Analyst API to Spend ledger: Appends one line per model call (request and reply)
Analyst API to Saved reports: Saves and reads reports (request and reply)
Analyst API to Model recordings: Reads in replay, writes in record (request and reply)
Analyst API to OpenRouter: Chat completions in live or record mode (request and reply)
make ask CLI to OpenRouter: Chat completions from make ask (request and reply)
Product manager or analyst to jsDelivr CDN: Browser loads chart scripts for an HTML report (request and reply)
a box inside a service is a module; the cylinder marks a service that owns its data; a dashed box is outside our control
